name: cardgame-lore-docs-game-name-references
title: Add "Wreck Tangle" game-name references to design/world.md, design/lore.md, and design/star-atlas.md — the last unclaimed piece of the 2026-07-29 naming directive
pitch: design/ideas-inbox.md's 2026-07-29 entry asked "Wreck Tangle" to propagate through "the rulebook title, the design-shelf site, the card set docs, and lore references to the game itself" — rules.md and site/index.html already name it (test/design-game-name.test.js), but world.md, lore.md, and star-atlas.md never mention the game by name.
why_now: Verified live: grepping design/*.md and design/cards/*.md for the literal string "Wreck Tangle" returns exactly 3 hits — design/DESIGN-READINESS.md, design/rules.md (title line 1: "# Wreck Tangle — Core Rules", and line 3: "*Wreck Tangle* is set in the Amaranth Expanse"), and design/ideas-inbox.md (the directive itself). test/design-game-name.test.js (the only existing mechanical check) covers exactly 2 of the directive's 4 named targets: rules.md's title and site/index.html (regenerated from build-site.js) — it does not touch world.md, lore.md, star-atlas.md, or any design/cards/*.md file. Read design/world.md (title "# The Amaranth Expanse", opening "The Setting" section), design/lore.md (title "# The Long Record — A Chronicle of the Amaranth Expanse"), and design/star-atlas.md (title "# The Star Atlas") in full: none names the game anywhere, only the setting. This unit deliberately excludes design/cards/*.md (the 'card set docs' part of the directive) because units/cardgame-playtest-second-deck-pairing (filed, not yet built) has AC5 requiring 'every design/cards/*.md file... byte-for-byte unchanged', and the window-open cardgame-playtest-spatial-wormhole-coverage proposal separately claims design/playtest-spatial.md — touching either file class right now risks exactly the kind of same-file collision T17 already burned a unit on. Checked memory and all 5 currently window-open proposals (character-signatures-wave-3, alt-art-briefs-character-signatures, character-markdown-slugify-dedup, jaina-sync-tools-dryrun-cli-dedup, playtest-spatial-wormhole-coverage) plus all 4 in-flight units (design-readiness-gap3-jaina-sync-fix, lib-markdown-section-parser-dedup, playtest-character-signatures-wave-2-refresh, playtest-second-deck-pairing) per T24: none touches design/world.md, design/lore.md, or design/star-atlas.md.
expected_outcome: design/world.md, design/lore.md, and design/star-atlas.md each contain the exact string "Wreck Tangle" at least once, each phrased to preserve ideas-inbox.md's own distinction ("'The Amaranth Expanse' remains the SETTING name... Wreck Tangle is the GAME") rather than renaming any file's title; site/design/world.html, site/design/lore.html, and site/design/star-atlas.html are regenerated via tools/build-site.js to match; a new test file mechanically confirms all 3 markdown files and all 3 regenerated site pages contain the string, and that design/rules.md, site/index.html, and every design/cards/*.md file are byte-for-byte unchanged.
intent: design/ideas-inbox.md's 2026-07-29 entry names the game "Wreck Tangle" and states: "The name should propagate through the rulebook title, the design-shelf site, the card set docs, and lore references to the game itself." test/design-game-name.test.js already locks in the first two targets (design/rules.md's title, site/index.html). The remaining 'lore references to the game itself' target is unclaimed: design/world.md (the setting overview), design/lore.md ("The Long Record", the eras chronicle), and design/star-atlas.md (the world atlas) never mention "Wreck Tangle" anywhere, even though each is exactly the kind of lore document the directive means. Add one sentence to each of the 3 files — near the top, after the H1 title, not replacing it — naming the game "Wreck Tangle" and preserving the setting/game distinction ideas-inbox.md itself states ("The Amaranth Expanse" stays the SETTING name; "Wreck Tangle" is the GAME). For design/world.md, the sentence belongs in or right after "The Setting" section. For design/lore.md, it belongs in the "Summary" section, naturally alongside its existing reference to "the present day the Alpha card set is set in." For design/star-atlas.md, it belongs in the opening paragraph, alongside its existing framing of what the atlas is for. Do not change any file's H1 title, do not touch design/rules.md, site/index.html, design/ideas-inbox.md, or any design/cards/*.md or design/playtest-*.md file — this unit is purely additive to 3 lore files. Regenerate site/design/world.html, site/design/lore.html, and site/design/star-atlas.html via tools/build-site.js. Add one new test file that mechanically asserts the string "Wreck Tangle" appears in all 3 markdown files and all 3 regenerated site pages, and that design/rules.md, site/index.html, and every file under design/cards/ are unchanged from their current content.

criteria.text: design/world.md contains the string "Wreck Tangle" at least once, and its H1 title ("# The Amaranth Expanse") is unchanged
design/lore.md contains the string "Wreck Tangle" at least once, and its H1 title is unchanged
design/star-atlas.md contains the string "Wreck Tangle" at least once, and its H1 title is unchanged
design/rules.md, site/index.html, and every file under design/cards/ are byte-for-byte unchanged from their content before this unit
